notes.title: Update for April 30, 2025
notes.content:
Grand Piano Simulator has been updated!

Make the camera mode switchable.
* EDIT Mode
    This is a mode where you can edit the camera's placement.
* VIEW Mode
    This is a viewing mode that prevents the camera's placement from being moved.
* AUTOSWITCH Mode
    This is a mode that automatically switches between cameras. You can change the switching interval by modifying the Transition.

[list]
[*] Display a dialog to allow key configuration upon the first launch.
[*] Modify the application so that save data can be reset with the Delete key upon startup.
[*] Allow free placement of lights in the Empty scene. Resetting will place three initial lights.
[*] Fixed several bugs in the level editor.
[/list]

If old version level data remains, objects may not be displayed correctly.
In that case, either reposition the objects in the level editor or initialize with the reset button.
You can also reset by pressing the Delete key on the loading screen at startup.

notes.title: Update for April 16, 2025

notes.title: Update for March 13, 2025

Update Information

notes.title: Update for October 22, 2024
notes.content:
Create your own personalized performance space.
Arrange a wide range of objects, from tables and beds to trees and lights, to design your ideal stage.
Freely adjust the layout and size of objects to make it uniquely yours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118315/37be3e139e0360c6eb9ad52c83d6a7f6e8d418bb.png[/img]

Editor mode can be activated by pressing the Level Editor button within the Options menu.

Four tools are available for your use, each represented by an icon in the upper right corner of the screen. These tools include:
・Selection Tool
・Move Tool
・Rotate Tool
・Scale Tool

To place an object, simply drag and drop it from the resource window located in the lower left corner of the interface.

The properties window allows you to directly modify an object's position, rotation, and scale.

To select and highlight a specific object, click on its corresponding entry in the object list.

To exit editor mode, simply press the Escape key.

Upon exiting, scene data is saved automatically. 
However, you also have the option to manually save your data using the import and export functions.

notes.title: Patch notes for August 20, 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118315/8581dfb18287a5124b9c9c9feb9264b7e85157b7.png[/img]
[h3]Enhanced Keyboard Input:[/h3]
Play single notes, chords, and use advanced features like transpose and sustain pedal with customizable keyboard assignments.
Fine-tune your playing experience with precise control over your keyboard setup.
[h3]Improved Audio:[/h3]
Updated audio drivers to significantly reduce latency.
Experience more accurate and responsive note triggering.
[h3]MIDI Device :[/h3]
Select your preferred MIDI input device and channel for a more personalized experience.
[h3]Multilingual Support:[/h3]
Enjoy the game in your preferred language with our new multilingual UI.
Currently supported languages include Arabic, Chinese, English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
Numerous bug fixes have been implemented to improve overall stability and gameplay.
